about: Test card: one input per shape. 'expect' is the output we call correct; 'shape' is a regex the whole output must match, for inputs whose pick is random (run over seeds 1..100). 'fixedIn' is the @spintax/core version whose changelog names the fix; 'issue' is the spintax-js issue.
